item.title: Chevrolet Corvette C3 Removable Hardtop at No Reserve
item.description: This removable fiberglass hardtop is intended for a C3 Corvette and has been refurbished with a replacement headliner, weatherstripping, and a repaint in blue. This C3 hardtop was acquired by the owner 25 years ago and is now offered by the seller on their behalf at no reserve in La Verne, California.

item.title: 1993 Land Rover Defender 110 NAS
item.description: This 1993 Land Rover Defender 110 NAS is #261 of approximately 525 North American Specification examples produced for the single model year, and it was disassembled and refurbished following the current owner's purchase in 2024. item.title: 2008 Cadillac XLR-V
item.description: This 2008 Cadillac XLR-V has 56k miles and is powered by a supercharged 4.4-liter Northstar V8 paired with a six-speed automatic transmission. item.title: Twin-Turbocharged 2014 Lamborghini Gallardo LP570-4 Squadra Corse 6-Speed Conversion
item.description: This 2014 Lamborghini Gallardo LP570-4 is one of 50 Squadra Corse cars built, 15 of which were designated for the US market. The car was acquired by the current owner in 2019 and subsequently underwent over $99k of work including installation of a Gintani twin-turbo kit as well as a six-speed manual conversion from 2020 to 2023. item.title: 2021 Porsche 911 GT3 Cup
item.description: This 2021 Porsche 911 GT3 Cup is said to have been campaigned by a racing team in France before it was purchased by the seller in 2021 and brought to the US. The car features aluminum-steel composite bodywork finished in silver, and power comes from a 4.0-liter flat-six linked with a six-speed sequential transaxle and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 1963 Fiat-Abarth Monomille GT Bialbero-Specification Race Car
item.description: This 1963 Fiat-Abarth Monomille GT is a faired-headlight version with aluminum coachwork by Sibona & Basano. Chassis 110-0380 is believed to have been initially imported to North America by Al Cosentino, founder of Fiat Abarth Zagato Allemano (FAZA), with the intention of displaying the car during the 1963 New York Auto Salon. item.description: This 1979 Ferrari 308 GTB was sold new at Hollywood Sport Cars in California, sold on BaT in March 2021, and recently acquired by the selling dealer. item.title: 1966 Shelby Cobra 427
item.description: This 1966 Shelby Cobra, CSX3272, was crashed in the late 1970s and rebuilt by Mike McClusky using a Brian Angliss/Autokraft chassis and alloy body. The new car was stamped with the original chassis number and the original car's engine and drivetrain, suspension parts, instrument panel, and gauges were transferred over.
